name: MAS Financial Services Ltd
title: MAS Financial Services Ltd - 540749 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Consolidated PAT up 21% to INR379 crores and AUM up 19% to INR15,304 crores, with standalone net Stage 3 steady at 1.70%, but cost of borrowing down only 42bps and credit cost guided 1.0-1.25% alongside a 1.5-1.6% watch.

triggers.label: Borrowing cost 9.75% → 9.39%
triggers.quote: the incremental cost of borrowing is now 9.39%, what used to be around 9.75% to 9.8%

triggers.label: Write-offs ahead of 360-day policy
triggers.quote: we have written off more than 0.10% of the assets aggressively rather than showing higher profitability

triggers.label: CV book growth slowed deliberately
triggers.quote: this book should grow at a slower pace for coming 1 or 2 quarters

guidance.quote: we continue to follow the strategy of a prudent growth, a profitable growth, and that too anywhere between 20% to 25%
it can be anywhere between 1% to 1.25% on our closing AUM
we can see this going down to around, say, 9.20% to 9.25% over next 2 -3 quarters

guidance.metric: ROA after opex and credit cost
guidance.quote: that is what allows us to maintain the ROAs anywhere between 2.75% to 3%
it may take a quarter more now
we should see the increase in branches from anywhere from 30 to 35 branches this year
